title: Jharkhand State Employee Health Insurance Scheme Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Group health insurance scheme for Jharkhand state employees, pensioners and other notified beneficiary groups and their dependants.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligible state employees, pensioners/family pensioners and other notified categories subject to registration and approval.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Jharkhand State Employee Health Insurance Scheme.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
